instruction: My roommate asked me to return something I had ordered for them and venmo them the money for it. Check my messages for details and do as per their instruction.
notes: Three-app task: phone (read roommate's text instruction), amazon (initiate return of the ordered item), venmo (send the item's cost to the roommate). Static structural facts in :init (contact-phone, message-about, order-contains, order-item-cost, ...) link the entities so the planner retrieves roommate contact info, the product named in the message, the order/product ids, quantity and cost before acting; knowledge predicates (known-phone, known-email, known-product, known-id, known-quantity, known-cost) model information discovered by lookups. Goal demands exactly one return (order + product) and one venmo transaction to the roommate for the order cost, matching the evaluation (ProductReturn added for order_id/product_id, Transaction to roommate with amount == order_cost). supervisor-complete-task carries the task records as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the goal conditions. Passwords: phone username is the supervisor phone number, amazon/venmo username is the supervisor email. Deliverer choice is unconstrained by evaluation; use any (or the one the message names). gmail/file_system changes in the evaluation are side effects of initiate_return, not separate actions.
